name: away_with_active_natvent_transition__hvac_fan
description: [hvac_fan twin of golden 'away_with_active_natvent_transition'; Issue #1193] Warm day: nat-vent running at home. User leaves (occupancy_away) at 15:00. Production only changes the setpoint to setback_cool â€” nat-vent continues running. There is no explicit nat-vent exit event on occupancy transition.
source: Issue #1193: hvac_fan twin of golden 'away_with_active_natvent_transition' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.
notes: Production handle_occupancy_away() does NOT deactivate nat-vent. It only changes the setpoint.
Nat-vent continues until a natural exit condition fires: outdoor rises, comfort floor hit, threshold exceeded.
This scenario verifies: (1) away setback is applied, (2) nat-vent state is NOT prematurely exited.
The assertion that nat-vent is still active after away transition documents production behavior.

hvac_fan twin (Issue #1193): with the HVAC fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air is ventilation (fan on), not a pause. This scenario pins the ventilation/exit/setback decision only; it deliberately does NOT assert the cool setpoint that production also arms during hvac_fan ventilation (nat_vent_ac_assist_armed), which is the rule-3 question tracked in #1142.

events.note: Morning: indoor 73.5F, outdoor 65F â€” nat-vent favorable
Window opens: nat-vent activates (outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, below threshold 77F)
User leaves. Production: only setpoint changes to setback_cool. Nat-vent continues.

[hvac_fan twin] Away transition applies setback_cool=79F. This is the only change production makes.

[hvac_fan twin] After away transition, nat-vent state flag must still be True. Production does not exit nat-vent on occupancy change â€” only the setpoint changes. Checks SimState.natural_vent_active directly.

verdict.summary: [hvac_fan twin] Away transition changes setpoint only; nat-vent continues running (production behavior)
verdict.observed_behavior: occupancy_away fires -> setback_applied (79F); nat-vent flag remains active
verdict.expected_behavior: Leaving home while nat-vent is active: only setpoint changes. No explicit nat-vent exit event. Nat-vent exits naturally when outdoor conditions change.
